preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 10,000.
The integer k is between 1 and the length of the string s.
The length of the string s is a multiple of k.

postconditions.description: The number of lines in the output is equal to the number of substrings of length k.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == len(set(line)) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line in the output contains only unique characters.

postconditions.expression: all(''.join(sorted(line)) == ''.join(sorted(t)) for line, t in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [s[i:i+k] for i in range(0, len(s), k)]))
postconditions.description: The characters in each line maintain the original order of their first occurrence in the corresponding substring.
